title: Bronchospasm: peak rises, plateau does not
summary: Airway resistance climbs to 2.5× over 20 s. In volume control Ppeak rises while Pplat (pause) barely moves: the extra pressure is resistive. Expiration lengthens.
objectives: Use Ppeak − Pplat to separate resistive from elastic pressure.
Bronchodilator (remove the injector) and watch Ppeak fall back.
